title: Slimbook EVO Ryzen 7 8845HS Mysteriously Shuts Down Every 15 Minutes
body: I've had this laptop for about a year, and around two months ago it began exhibiting this strange behavior. Whenever I put it under load (e.g. playing TETR.IO, etc.) it immediately shuts down when on battery power and refuses to boot until PSU is connected. It also appears to just do this every 15 minutes and is also causing me some grief, as every time I am searching for fixes it shuts down. I'm pretty sure this isn't malware (I checked /tmp), but I am open to the possibility. I'm also a newbie here, so please be nice . On that note, if you can find the minimum possible fix, that'd be great! It'd be amazing to use my laptop normally again.
